name: Judith Aston
reason: Not spiritual teaching, and clinical in framing: her own site (astonkinetics.com, robots.txt allows us) presents Aston Kinetics as continuing education in movement, bodywork, postural assessment and ergonomics for therapists (massage, physical and occupational therapists) 'to better help their clients/patients', plus ergonomic cushions and private bodywork sessions. That is bodywork therapy training rather than spiritual teaching, so it falls under the health rule's therapy exclusion.
